file_roles.evidence: Adds MAX_POLL_INTERVAL_MS_CONFIG=300000 to consumer default overrides so StreamThread can read it; supports the fix, no wrong logic corrected.
retryWithBackoff loop now breaks when time.milliseconds() - start > rebalanceTimeoutMs, bounding the previously infinite retry; backoff is also reset after success.

rationale: The report is an unbounded retry loop. The diff adds the time bound in that loop. The config default only supplies the value the new bound needs.
notes: StreamsConfig could also be read as preventive (configuration).
